reasons: Section 18.1 matches the playbook's preferred limits exactly (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law), plus employer's liability and a one-year tail.
Section 18.2 supplies certificates on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage and non-limitation of liability — all favourable to us; correctly classified as compliant.
No redline or comment proposed, which is the expected posture for a compliant finding; deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
